title: Shigeru Mizuki's 'White Flag' WW2 Manga Gets Anime Special on Sunday
content: NHK announced on Friday that it will air a special anime based on Shigeru Mizuki 's "Shiroi Hata" (White Flag) manga for its NHK Special documentary program on Sunday, August 16. The special is titled "Iwo Jima no Shiroi Hata" (The White Flag at Iwo Jima).
author: ANN

title: The Villager of Level 999 Anime Casts Yōji Ueda, Tetsu Inada
content: The staff of the television anime of Koneko Hoshitsuki 's The Villager of Level 999 ( Level 999 no Murabito ) light novel series revealed two new cast members for the anime on Friday. The new cast members will play characters who will both appear in the anime's eighth episode next Thursday.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Tengu no Daidokoro Season 3 Reveals More Cast, October 1 Debut
content: BS-TBS revealed a new visual, cast members, and the October 1 premiere date for the third season of the live-action series based on Ai Tanaka 's Tengu no Daidokoro (Tengu's Kitchen) manga on Friday.
author: ANN

title: Hell Mode Anime Season 2 Unveils More Cast
content: The official website for the television anime of writer Hamuo and illustrator Mo 's Hell Mode - The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing ( Hell Mode - Yarikomi Suki no Gamer wa Hai Settei no Isekai de Musō Suru ) light novel series unveiled more cast members for the second season on Friday.
author: ANN

title: 6 Years Later, WIT Studio CEO Breaks Silence on Handing Over Attack on Titan to MAPPA
content: Based on the acclaimed manga by Hajime Isayama, the anime adaptation of Attack on Titan reached unprecedented heights of popularity after its debut in 2013. The series was initially adapted by the renowned WIT Studio and released the first three seasons of the anime.
author: ComicBook

title: 5 Years Later, Tokyo Revengers Is All Set For Its Finale With a Major Update
content: Crunchyroll will be returning with the final season of Tokyo Revengers this year, three years after the previous season, which adapted the Tenjiku Arc. The series is based on the Weekly Shonen Jump manga by Ken Wakui, known for one of the most controversial endings of all time.
author: ComicBook

title: Legendary Creator Returns With a New Look At The Manga Perfect Story For 2026
content: Naoki Urasawa is one of the most legendary manga creators of all time. Almost all of his works are always praised among readers for their exceptional art style and storytelling. While the creator is best known for Monster, a 1994 manga, he has also worked on more than a dozen titles.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Biggest Isekai Has a Disappointing Update After Its Return
content: The highly anticipated Spring 2026 anime season is finally over, and fans now have to bid farewell to some of their favorite shows. However, this doesn’t include Re:Zero − Starting Life in Another World Season 4, which continues Subaru’s journey.
author: ComicBook
